_doc: Chapter III. 프랑스어는 1914년판 『Brieven aan zijn broeder』(요 반 고흐-봉어 엮음, 공공 영역, archive.org 스캔)에서 옮김. 스캔 OCR이 떨어뜨린 악센트와 글자 오류만 바로잡았고(eher→cher, vice verqa→vice versa, en fin→enfin, cendre→cendré, oblique→obliqué, 6/ä→é/à 등), 빈센트의 철자 impressioniste는 impressionniste로 맞춤; 537번은 쪽 스캔 전사본을 따름. 영어 · 한국어는 이 앱의 새 번역이고, 그림은 소장처가 자유 사용을 밝힌 것 또는 위키미디어 공용의 공공 영역(PD-Art) 이미지.

letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 533 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: 3 nuits durant j'ai veillé à peindre, en me couchant pendant la journée.
messages.en: For 3 nights running I stayed up painting, and slept during the day.
messages.ko: 사흘 밤을 꼬박 새우며 그렸어. 잠은 낮에 잤고.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: 3 nuits durant / j'ai veillé à peindre, // en me couchant / pendant la journée.

messages.fr: Souvent il me semble que la nuit est bien plus vivante et richement colorée que le jour.
messages.en: It often seems to me that the night is much more alive and richly coloured than the day.
messages.ko: 밤이 낮보다 훨씬 살아 있고 색이 풍부하다는 생각이 자주 들어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Souvent il me semble / que la nuit est bien plus vivante / et richement colorée / que le jour.

messages.fr: J'ai cherché à exprimer avec le rouge et le vert les terribles passions humaines.
messages.en: I've tried to express the terrible human passions with red and green.
messages.ko: 빨강과 초록으로 사람의 무서운 정념을 나타내 보려고 했어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: J'ai cherché à exprimer / avec le rouge et le vert // les terribles passions humaines.

messages.fr: La salle est rouge sang et jaune sourd, un billard vert au milieu, 4 lampes jaune citron à rayonnement orangé et vert.
messages.en: The room is blood red and dull yellow, a green billiard table in the middle, 4 lemon-yellow lamps with an orange and green glow.
messages.ko: 방은 핏빛 빨강과 탁한 노랑이고, 가운데에 초록 당구대가 있어. 레몬빛 노란 램프 4개가 주황과 초록으로 빛을 퍼뜨리고.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: La salle est rouge sang / et jaune sourd, // un billard vert au milieu, // 4 lampes jaune citron / à rayonnement orangé et vert.

note.ko: 밤의 카페는 노란 집이 있는 라마르틴 광장의 역 앞 카페예요. 빈센트는 이 카페 주인 지누에게 방을 빌려 지내고 있었어요. 테오가 보낸 300프랑은 노란 집 가구를 사려고 빌려 달라던 돈이에요.
note.en: The night café was the Café de la Gare on place Lamartine, near the Yellow House. Vincent rented a room there from the owner, Ginoux. Theo's 300 francs were the loan Vincent had asked for to furnish the Yellow House.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 533 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Night_Café

plate.collection: Yale University Art Gallery, New Haven · Open Access
plate.why: The painting this letter describes; Yale's open-access policy needs no permission for public-domain works.

note.ko: 방 한가운데 초록 당구대. 빨간 벽과 부딪치는 초록이에요.
note.en: The green billiard table in the middle, clashing with the red walls.

note.ko: 레몬빛 램프. 둘레에 주황 · 초록 빛무리가 번져요.
note.en: Lemon-yellow lamps, each with an orange and green halo.

note.ko: ‘빨강과 초록으로 사람의 무서운 정념을’.
note.en: ‘The terrible human passions with red and green’.

replies.fr: Tu as peint trois nuits de suite ; ça t'a beaucoup fatigué ?
replies.en: You painted for three nights. Did it tire you a lot?
replies.ko: 사흘 밤을 새워 그려서 많이 피곤했어요?
replies.koLow: 사흘 밤을 새워 그려서 많이 피곤했어?
replies.koHigh: 사흘 밤을 새워 그리셔서 많이 피곤하셨습니까?

replies.fr: La nuit est si vivante ? Est-ce que tu dors un peu, alors ?
replies.en: Is the night so alive? Do you sleep at all, then?
replies.ko: 밤이 그렇게 살아 있어요? 그럼 잠은 안 자요?
replies.koLow: 밤이 그렇게 살아 있어? 그럼 잠은 안 자?
replies.koHigh: 밤이 그렇게 살아 있습니까? 그럼 잠은 안 주무십니까?

status.fr: La nuit, plus vivante que le jour

q.fr: Pendant trois nuits, qu'a fait Vincent ?
q.en: What did Vincent do for three nights?
q.ko: 빈센트는 사흘 밤 동안 무엇을 했나요?

scene.ko: 사흘 밤을 새워 밤의 카페를 그린 빈센트와 통화
scene.en: On the phone with Vincent after three nights painting a night café

lines.fr: Théo, j'ai peint toute la nuit, trois nuits !
lines.en: Theo, I painted all night, three nights!

lines.fr: Trois nuits ? Tu as dormi un peu ?
lines.en: Three nights? Did you sleep a bit?

lines.fr: Oui, le jour. Le café est rouge et vert.
lines.en: Yes, in the daytime. The café is red and green.

lines.fr: Et toi, ça va ? Tu n'as pas froid la nuit ?
lines.en: And you, OK? Aren't you cold at night?

letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 537 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: Je compte aller habiter la maison demain, seulement ayant encore acheté des choses et en ayant encore à ajouter — et je ne parle que du strict nécessaire — il faudra que tu m'envoies encore une fois 100 francs au lieu de 50.
messages.en: I'm planning to move into the house tomorrow; only, since I've bought more things and still have more to add — and I'm speaking only of the bare necessities — you'll have to send me 100 francs once more instead of 50.
messages.ko: 내일 그 집에 들어가 살 생각이야. 다만 물건을 더 샀고 아직 더 들여야 해서 — 꼭 필요한 것만 말하는 거야 — 이번에도 50프랑 말고 100프랑을 보내 줘야겠어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Je compte aller habiter la maison demain, // seulement ayant encore acheté des choses / et en ayant encore à ajouter // — et je ne parle que du strict nécessaire — // il faudra que tu m'envoies / encore une fois 100 francs / au lieu de 50.

messages.fr: De cette dernière catégorie est une toile de 30 carrée, qui représente un coin de jardin avec un arbre pleureur, de l'herbe, des buissons taillés en boule de cèdre, un buisson de laurier rose.
messages.en: One of these is a square size-30 canvas showing a corner of a garden with a weeping tree, grass, cedar bushes clipped into balls, and an oleander bush.
messages.ko: 그런 그림 가운데 하나가 30호 정사각 캔버스야. 정원 한구석인데, 가지가 늘어진 나무, 풀밭, 공처럼 둥글게 다듬은 백향목 덤불, 협죽도 덤불이 있어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: De cette dernière catégorie / est une toile de 30 carrée, // qui représente un coin de jardin / avec un arbre pleureur, // de l'herbe, // des buissons taillés en boule de cèdre, // un buisson de laurier rose.

messages.fr: Le deuxième représente l'extérieur d'un café, illuminé sur la terrasse par une grande lanterne de gaz dans la nuit bleue, avec un coin de ciel bleu étoilé.
messages.en: The second shows the outside of a café, its terrace lit by a big gas lantern in the blue night, with a patch of starry blue sky.
messages.ko: 두 번째는 어느 카페의 바깥 모습이야. 파란 밤 속에서 커다란 가스 랜턴이 테라스를 환히 비추고, 한쪽엔 별이 총총한 파란 하늘이 보여.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Le deuxième / représente l'extérieur d'un café, // illuminé sur la terrasse / par une grande lanterne de gaz / dans la nuit bleue, // avec un coin de ciel bleu étoilé.

messages.fr: Le troisième tableau de cette semaine est un portrait de moi-même presque décoloré, des tons cendrés sur un fond véronèse pâle.
messages.en: The third picture this week is a portrait of myself, almost colourless: ashen tones on a pale Veronese-green background.
messages.ko: 이번 주 세 번째 그림은 색을 거의 뺀 내 자화상이야. 옅은 베로네세 녹색 바탕에 잿빛 톤으로.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Le troisième tableau de cette semaine / est un portrait de moi-même / presque décoloré, // des tons cendrés / sur un fond véronèse pâle.

messages.fr: La question de peindre les scènes ou effets de nuit sur place et la nuit même, m'intéresse énormément. Cette semaine je n'ai absolument rien fait que peindre et dormir et prendre mes repas.
messages.en: The question of painting night scenes or night effects on the spot, at night itself, interests me enormously. This week I've done absolutely nothing but paint, sleep and eat my meals.
messages.ko: 밤 풍경이나 밤의 효과를 바로 그 자리에서, 그 밤에 그리는 문제가 몹시 흥미로워. 이번 주엔 정말이지 그리고 자고 밥 먹은 것 말고는 아무것도 안 했어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: La question de peindre / les scènes ou effets de nuit / sur place et la nuit même, // m'intéresse énormément. // Cette semaine / je n'ai absolument rien fait / que peindre et dormir / et prendre mes repas.

note.ko: 이 그림이 편지 속 두 번째 그림, 파란 밤 속 카페 테라스예요. 카페는 아를의 포룸 광장에 있었어요. 편지에 나오는 정원 한구석 그림과 잿빛 자화상은 여기 싣지 않았어요. 빈센트는 이 편지를 쓴 다음 날 노란 집에 들어가 살 생각이었어요.
note.en: This is the second picture of the letter, the café terrace in the blue night. The café stood on the place du Forum in Arles. The garden corner and the ashen self-portrait the letter also describes are not shown here. Vincent meant to move into the Yellow House the day after writing this letter.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 537 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Van_Gogh_-_Terrace_of_a_Café_at_Night_(Place_du_Forum)_1888.jpg

plate.why: The café terrace this letter describes; PD-Art from Wikimedia Commons.

note.ko: 차양 아래 벽에 걸린 커다란 랜턴. 테라스 전체를 노랗게 밝혀요.
note.en: The big lantern on the wall under the awning, turning the whole terrace yellow.

note.ko: 등불 아래 주황빛 바닥과 둥근 탁자들. 손님들이 앉아 있어요.
note.en: Orange floor and round tables under the light, with people seated.

note.ko: 지붕 사이로 보이는 ‘별이 총총한 파란 하늘 한 귀퉁이’.
note.en: Between the roofs, ‘a patch of starry blue sky’.

replies.fr: Tu as peint toute la semaine, et j'ai eu peur pour ta santé.
replies.en: You painted all week, and I worried about your health.
replies.ko: 형이 일주일 내내 그려서 건강이 걱정됐어요.
replies.koLow: 형이 일주일 내내 그려서 건강이 걱정됐어.
replies.koHigh: 형님이 일주일 내내 그리셔서 건강이 걱정됐습니다.

replies.fr: Tu as peint le café sous les étoiles ? Envoie-moi un croquis.
replies.en: You painted the café under the stars? Send me a sketch.
replies.ko: 별 아래 카페를 그렸어요? 스케치 좀 보내 줘요.
replies.koLow: 별 아래 카페를 그렸어? 스케치 좀 보내 줘.
replies.koHigh: 별 아래 카페를 그리셨습니까? 스케치 좀 보내 주십시오.

text.fr: Vincent compte habiter la maison jaune dès demain
text.en: Vincent means to move into the Yellow House tomorrow
text.ko: 빈센트, 내일 노란 집으로 들어갈 예정

caption.fr: La terrasse du café, dans la nuit bleue
caption.en: The café terrace, in the blue night

q.en: How much money does Vincent ask for?
q.ko: 빈센트는 테오에게 얼마를 보내 달라고 하나요?

scene.ko: 집에 들어갈 준비를 하는 빈센트의 부탁
scene.en: Vincent, getting ready to move into the house, asks a favour

lines.fr: Théo, j'ai acheté des meubles pour la maison.
lines.en: Theo, I've bought some furniture for the house.

lines.fr: Super ! Tu as déjà tout ?
lines.en: Great! Have you got everything already?

lines.fr: Pas encore. Je dois ajouter des choses. Tu peux m'aider ?
lines.en: Not yet. I need to add a few things. Can you help me?
lines.ko: 아직이요. 더 들일 게 있어요. 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?

lines.fr: Bien sûr. Je t'envoie cent francs, d'accord ?
lines.en: Of course. I'll send you a hundred francs, OK?

letters.dateNote: Undated in the 1914 edition beyond its header (September.); written in Arles in September 1888.
letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 543 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: Le temps ici reste beau, et si c'était toujours comme cela, ce serait mieux que le paradis des peintres, ce serait du Japon en plein.
messages.en: The weather here stays fine, and if it were always like this, it would be better than the painters' paradise; it would be Japan through and through.
messages.ko: 여기 날씨는 계속 좋아. 늘 이렇다면 화가들의 낙원보다도 나을 거야. 그야말로 일본 그 자체겠지.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Le temps ici reste beau, // et si c'était toujours comme cela, // ce serait mieux / que le paradis des peintres, // ce serait du Japon en plein.

messages.fr: Ci-inclus petit croquis d'une toile de 30 carrée, enfin le ciel étoilé peint la nuit même sous un bec de gaz.
messages.en: Enclosed is a little sketch of a square size-30 canvas: the starry sky at last, painted at night itself, under a gas lamp.
messages.ko: 30호 정사각 캔버스의 작은 스케치를 같이 넣었어. 드디어 별이 빛나는 하늘이야. 바로 그 밤에, 가스등 아래서 그렸어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Ci-inclus petit croquis / d'une toile de 30 carrée, // enfin le ciel étoilé / peint la nuit même / sous un bec de gaz.

messages.fr: Le ciel est bleu vert, l'eau est bleu de roi, les terrains sont mauves. La ville est bleue et violette, le gaz est jaune et des reflets sont or roux et descendent jusqu'au bronze vert.
messages.en: The sky is blue-green, the water royal blue, the ground mauve. The town is blue and violet, the gas is yellow, and the reflections are russet gold, going down to green bronze.
messages.ko: 하늘은 청록색, 물은 짙은 파랑, 땅은 연보라야. 도시는 파랑과 보라, 가스등은 노랑이고, 물에 비친 빛은 붉은 금빛에서 초록빛 청동까지 내려가.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Le ciel est bleu vert, // l'eau est bleu de roi, // les terrains sont mauves. // La ville est bleue et violette, // le gaz est jaune / et des reflets sont or roux // et descendent / jusqu'au bronze vert.

messages.fr: Sur le champ bleu vert du ciel, la grande ourse a un scintillement vert et rose, dont la pâleur discrète contraste avec l'or brutal du gaz. Deux figurines colorées d'amoureux à l'avant-plan.
messages.en: On the blue-green field of the sky the Great Bear sparkles green and pink, its quiet paleness contrasting with the harsh gold of the gas. Two small coloured figures of lovers in the foreground.
messages.ko: 청록빛 하늘 위에서 큰곰자리가 초록과 분홍으로 반짝여. 그 은은하고 옅은 빛이 가스등의 거친 금빛과 대비를 이뤄. 앞쪽엔 알록달록한 연인 두 사람.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Sur le champ bleu vert du ciel, // la grande ourse / a un scintillement vert et rose, // dont la pâleur discrète / contraste avec l'or brutal du gaz. // Deux figurines colorées d'amoureux / à l'avant-plan.

messages.fr: Cela n'empêche, que j'ai un besoin terrible de — dirai-je le mot — de religion — alors je vais la nuit dehors pour peindre les étoiles, et je rêve toujours un tableau comme cela avec un groupe de figures vivantes des copains.
messages.en: Still, I have a terrible need of — shall I say the word — of religion — so I go outside at night to paint the stars, and I keep dreaming of a picture like that, with a group of living figures of our friends.
messages.ko: 그래도 나한텐 지독하게 필요한 게 있어. 말해 버릴까, 종교야. 그래서 밤이면 밖에 나가 별을 그려. 그리고 늘 그런 그림을 꿈꿔. 친구들이 살아 있는 모습으로 모여 있는 그림.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Cela n'empêche, / que j'ai un besoin terrible de // — dirai-je le mot — // de religion // — alors je vais la nuit dehors / pour peindre les étoiles, // et je rêve toujours un tableau comme cela / avec un groupe de figures vivantes / des copains.

note.ko: 빈센트는 이 그림을 노란 집에서 걸어서 몇 분 거리인 론강 강둑에서 그렸어요. 편지 속 ‘큰곰자리’는 북두칠성이 있는 별자리예요. 이 그림은 이듬해 파리의 앵데팡당전에 걸렸어요.
note.en: Vincent painted this picture on the bank of the Rhône, a few minutes' walk from the Yellow House. The ‘grande ourse’ of the letter is the Great Bear, the constellation of the Plough. The picture was shown in Paris the following year, at the Salon des Indépendants.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starry_Night_Over_the_Rhône

plate.why: The painting this letter describes; a public-domain image from Wikimedia Commons.

note.ko: 초록과 분홍으로 반짝이는 일곱 별.
note.en: Seven stars sparkling green and pink.

note.ko: 물 위로 길게 내려오는 가스등 빛. ‘붉은 금빛에서 초록빛 청동까지’.
note.en: Gaslight streaming down the water: ‘russet gold, going down to green bronze’.

note.ko: 앞쪽 강둑을 걷는 연인 두 사람.
note.en: Two lovers on the bank in the foreground.

replies.fr: J'ai ouvert ton croquis et j'ai longtemps regardé le ciel étoilé.
replies.en: I opened your sketch and looked at the starry sky for a long time.
replies.ko: 형 스케치를 펴서 별 하늘을 한참 봤어요.
replies.koLow: 형 스케치를 펴서 별 하늘을 한참 봤어.
replies.koHigh: 형님 스케치를 펴서 별 하늘을 한참 봤습니다.

replies.fr: Tu as besoin des étoiles, la nuit ? Moi aussi, parfois.
replies.en: You need the stars at night? So do I, sometimes.
replies.ko: 밤하늘의 별은 저한테도 가끔 꼭 필요한 위로예요.
replies.koLow: 밤하늘의 별은 나한테도 가끔 꼭 필요한 위로야.
replies.koHigh: 밤하늘의 별은 저에게도 가끔 꼭 필요한 위로입니다.

status.fr: Le ciel étoilé, sous un bec de gaz
status.en: The starry sky, under a gas lamp

q.fr: Sous quelle lumière Vincent peint-il le ciel étoilé ?
q.en: Under what light does Vincent paint the starry sky?
q.ko: 빈센트는 별이 빛나는 하늘을 어떤 불빛 아래서 그렸나요?

scene.ko: 밤하늘의 별을 그리고 온 빈센트와 저녁 통화
scene.en: An evening call with Vincent, back from painting the stars

lines.fr: Bonsoir, Théo ! Je suis allé peindre les étoiles.
lines.en: Good evening, Theo! I went out to paint the stars.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 테오! 별을 그리러 나갔다 왔어요.

lines.fr: La nuit ? Tu es sorti avec une lampe ?
lines.en: At night? Did you go out with a lamp?

lines.fr: Oui, sous le gaz. Le tableau est enfin fini !
lines.en: Yes, under the gas lamp. The painting is finished at last!
lines.ko: 네, 가스등 아래서요. 드디어 그림이 끝났어요!

lines.fr: Bravo ! Tu es rentré tard, non ?
lines.en: Well done! You got back late, didn't you?

letters.dateNote: Undated in the 1914 edition; it falls between letter 543 (September.) and letter 546 (October.), and is usually dated to the beginning of October 1888.
letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 545 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: Maintenant je viens de recevoir le portrait de Gauguin par lui-même et le portrait de Bernard par Bernard avec dans le fond du portrait de Gauguin celui de Bernard sur le mur et vice versa.
messages.en: I've just received Gauguin's portrait of himself and Bernard's portrait of Bernard, with Bernard's portrait on the wall in the background of Gauguin's, and vice versa.
messages.ko: 방금 고갱이 그린 고갱 자화상이랑 베르나르가 그린 베르나르 자화상을 받았어. 고갱 그림 뒤쪽 벽엔 베르나르의 초상이 걸려 있고, 베르나르 그림엔 거꾸로 고갱의 초상이 걸려 있어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Maintenant je viens de recevoir / le portrait de Gauguin par lui-même / et le portrait de Bernard par Bernard // avec dans le fond du portrait de Gauguin / celui de Bernard sur le mur / et vice versa.

messages.fr: … cherchant à rendre dans mon portrait non seulement moi, mais en général un impressionniste, j'avais conçu ce portrait comme celui d'un Bonze, simple adorateur du Bouddha éternel.
messages.en: … trying to render in my portrait not only myself but an impressionist in general, I had conceived this portrait as that of a bonze, a simple worshipper of the eternal Buddha.
messages.ko: … 내 초상에 나만이 아니라 인상주의자 일반을 담아 보려고, 이 초상을 승려의 모습으로 구상했어. 영원한 부처를 섬기는 소박한 승려 말이야.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: … cherchant à rendre dans mon portrait / non seulement moi, // mais en général un impressionniste, // j'avais conçu ce portrait / comme celui d'un Bonze, // simple adorateur / du Bouddha éternel.

messages.fr: Je suis très content d'avoir ces deux portraits, qui nous représentent les copains fidèlement à cette époque, ils ne resteront pas comme cela, ils reviendront à la vie plus sereine.
messages.en: I'm very glad to have these two portraits, which show us our friends faithfully as they are at this time; they won't stay like that, they'll come back to a more serene life.
messages.ko: 이 두 자화상이 생겨서 정말 기뻐. 지금 이 시절 친구들의 모습을 그대로 보여 주니까. 친구들이 계속 그렇진 않을 거야. 더 평온한 삶으로 돌아올 거야.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Je suis très content / d'avoir ces deux portraits, // qui nous représentent les copains fidèlement / à cette époque, // ils ne resteront pas comme cela, // ils reviendront / à la vie plus sereine.

messages.fr: C'est tout cendré contre du véronèse pâle (pas de jaune). Le vêtement est ce veston brun bordé de bleu, mais dont j'ai exagéré le brun jusqu'au pourpre et la largeur des bordures bleues.
messages.en: It's all ashen against pale Veronese green (no yellow). The clothes are that brown jacket edged with blue, but I've exaggerated the brown into purple, and the width of the blue borders.
messages.ko: 전체가 옅은 베로네세 녹색 바탕에 잿빛이야 (노랑은 없어). 옷은 파랑으로 테를 두른 그 갈색 웃옷인데, 갈색은 자줏빛까지, 파란 테는 더 넓게 과장했어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: C'est tout cendré / contre du véronèse pâle // (pas de jaune). // Le vêtement est ce veston brun / bordé de bleu, // mais dont j'ai exagéré le brun / jusqu'au pourpre // et la largeur des bordures bleues.

messages.fr: La tête est modelée en pleine pâte claire contre le fond clair sans ombres presque. Seulement j'ai obliqué un peu les yeux à la japonaise.
messages.en: The head is modelled in thick, light paint against the light background, almost without shadows. Only I've slanted the eyes a little, in the Japanese way.
messages.ko: 머리는 밝은 바탕 위에 밝은 물감을 두껍게 올려 빚었어. 그림자는 거의 없어. 다만 눈을 일본식으로 살짝 비스듬히 그렸어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: La tête est modelée / en pleine pâte claire / contre le fond clair / sans ombres presque. // Seulement / j'ai obliqué un peu les yeux / à la japonaise.

note.ko: 이 그림이 빈센트가 고갱에게 교환으로 보낸 바로 그 자화상이에요. 편지대로 머리를 짧게 깎은 ‘승려’의 모습에, 잿빛 얼굴과 옅은 녹색 바탕, 파란 테를 두른 갈색 웃옷이 보여요. 왼쪽 위에는 고갱에게 바친 헌사가 희미하게 남아 있어요. 고갱은 1888년 10월 23일 아를에 도착했어요.
note.en: This is the very self-portrait Vincent sent to Gauguin in exchange. As the letter says, he appears as a ‘bonze’ with close-cropped hair: an ashen face on a pale green ground, in the brown jacket edged with blue. The dedication to Gauguin can still be made out faintly at the top left. Gauguin arrived in Arles on 23 October 1888.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 545 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_Self-Portrait_Dedicated_to_Paul_Gauguin_-_1951.65_-_Fogg_Museum.jpg

plate.collection: Harvard Art Museums (Fogg Museum), Cambridge, Massachusetts · Public domain
plate.why: The self-portrait as a Bonze that this letter describes; PD-Art from Wikimedia Commons.

note.ko: 짧게 깎은 머리. ‘영원한 부처를 섬기는 소박한 승려’.
note.en: Close-cropped head: ‘a simple worshipper of the eternal Buddha’.

note.ko: ‘일본식으로 살짝 비스듬히’ 그린 눈.
note.en: Eyes ‘slanted a little, in the Japanese way’.

note.ko: 자줏빛까지 과장한 갈색 웃옷과 넓은 파란 테.
note.en: The brown jacket pushed towards purple, with wide blue borders.

replies.fr: Les deux portraits sont arrivés ? Quand est-ce que je peux venir les voir ?
replies.en: The two portraits came? When can I come and see them?
replies.ko: 두 초상화가 왔어요? 저는 언제 보러 가요?
replies.koLow: 두 초상화가 왔어? 나는 언제 보러 가?
replies.koHigh: 두 초상화가 왔습니까? 저는 언제 보러 가면 되겠습니까?

replies.fr: Tu as fait les yeux à la japonaise, et ça m'a rendu curieux.
replies.en: You made the eyes the Japanese way, and that made me curious.

text.fr: Arrivés à Arles : les portraits de Gauguin et de Bernard
text.en: Arrived in Arles: the self-portraits of Gauguin and Bernard

q.fr: Dans son portrait, Vincent se peint comme qui ?
q.en: How does Vincent picture himself in his portrait?

scene.en: On the phone with Vincent, who has just received his friends' portraits

lines.fr: Théo, j'ai reçu les portraits de Gauguin et Bernard.
lines.en: Theo, I've received the portraits of Gauguin and Bernard.

lines.fr: Ah, super ! Tu es content ?
lines.en: Oh, great! Are you happy?

lines.fr: Très content. J'ai fait mon portrait, un peu japonais.
lines.en: Very happy. I've done my own portrait, a bit Japanese.
lines.ko: 정말 기뻐요. 제 자화상도 그렸어요, 좀 일본풍으로요.

lines.fr: Japonais ? Tu as changé tes yeux ?
lines.en: Japanese? Did you change your eyes?

letters.dateNote: Undated in the 1914 edition beyond its header (October.); written in Arles in October 1888.
letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 546 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: Merci de ta lettre, mais j'ai bien langui cette fois-ci, mon argent était épuisé jeudi, ainsi jusqu'à lundi midi c'était bigrement long.
messages.en: Thanks for your letter, but I really pined this time: my money ran out on Thursday, so it was a damned long wait until Monday noon.
messages.ko: 편지 고마워. 그런데 이번엔 정말 힘들었어. 목요일에 돈이 다 떨어져서 월요일 점심까지 지독하게 길었거든.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Merci de ta lettre, // mais j'ai bien langui cette fois-ci, // mon argent était épuisé jeudi, // ainsi jusqu'à lundi midi / c'était bigrement long.

messages.fr: J'ai principalement vécu de 23 cafés ces 4 jours-là durant, avec du pain et que je dois encore payer. C'est pas de ta faute, c'est la mienne si faute il y a.
messages.en: For those 4 days I lived mainly on 23 coffees, with bread, and I still have to pay for them. It's not your fault; it's mine, if it's anyone's.
messages.ko: 그 나흘 동안 주로 커피 23잔으로 버텼어. 빵이랑 같이. 그것도 아직 갚아야 해. 네 잘못이 아니야. 잘못이 있다면 내 잘못이지.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: J'ai principalement vécu de 23 cafés / ces 4 jours-là durant, // avec du pain / et que je dois encore payer. // C'est pas de ta faute, // c'est la mienne / si faute il y a.

messages.fr: Car j'ai été enragé pour voir mes tableaux dans des cadres, et j'en avais un peu trop commandé pour le budget, vu que le mois de loyer et la femme de chambre devaient être payés aussi.
messages.en: Because I was mad to see my pictures in frames, and I'd ordered a few too many for the budget, seeing that the month's rent and the maid had to be paid too.
messages.ko: 내 그림들을 액자에 넣어 보고 싶어서 안달이 났거든. 그래서 예산보다 조금 많이 주문해 버렸어. 한 달 집세랑 가정부 삯도 내야 했는데.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Car j'ai été enragé / pour voir mes tableaux dans des cadres, // et j'en avais un peu trop commandé / pour le budget, // vu que le mois de loyer / et la femme de chambre / devaient être payés aussi.

messages.fr: Pour ma semaine sais-tu ce qui me reste aujourd'hui et cela après 4 jours de jeûne rigide ? Juste 6 francs.
messages.en: Do you know what I have left for my week today, and that after 4 days of strict fasting? Just 6 francs.
messages.ko: 이번 주를 버틸 돈이 오늘 얼마 남았는지 알아? 나흘을 꼬박 굶다시피 하고 나서 말이야. 딱 6프랑.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Pour ma semaine / sais-tu ce qui me reste aujourd'hui // et cela après 4 jours / de jeûne rigide ? // Juste 6 francs.

messages.fr: J'ai fait fabriquer pour les deux « jardin du poète » des cadres en noyer, qui font fort bien.
messages.en: I've had walnut frames made for the two ‘poet's garden’ canvases, and they look very good.
messages.ko: ‘시인의 정원’ 두 점에는 호두나무 액자를 맞췄어. 아주 잘 어울려.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: J'ai fait fabriquer / pour les deux « jardin du poète » // des cadres en noyer, // qui font fort bien.

note.ko: 1888년 가을, 빈센트는 고갱을 맞을 노란 집을 꾸미느라 가구를 들이고 그림마다 액자를 맞추면서 돈이 늘 모자랐어요. ‘시인의 정원’은 노란 집 맞은편, 라마르틴 광장의 공원을 그린 연작에 붙인 이름이에요. 그림은 그 연작 가운데 한 점인데, 호두나무 액자를 맞춘 두 점이 어느 것인지는 편지가 밝히지 않아요.
note.en: In autumn 1888, getting the Yellow House ready for Gauguin, Vincent was buying furniture and having his pictures framed, and money kept running short. ‘The poet's garden’ was his name for a series of paintings of the public garden on place Lamartine, across from the Yellow House. The picture is one of that series; the letter does not say which two canvases got the walnut frames.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 546 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://www.artic.edu/artworks/14586

plate.why: A canvas of the ‘poet's garden’ series this letter mentions; the Art Institute of Chicago releases it under CC0.

note.ko: 공원의 넓은 풀밭. 빈센트가 ‘시인의 정원’이라 부른 곳이에요.
note.en: The wide lawn of the public garden Vincent called ‘the poet's garden’.

note.ko: 가지가 아래로 늘어진 나무 한 그루. ‘시인의 정원’ 연작의 한 장면.
note.en: A tree with drooping branches, one view of the ‘poet's garden’ series.

replies.fr: Tu es resté quatre jours avec du café ! Tu sors manger, maintenant ?
replies.en: You went four days on coffee! Do you go out to eat now?
replies.ko: 나흘을 커피로 버텼군요! 이제는 밥 먹으러 나가요?
replies.koLow: 나흘을 커피로 버텼구나! 이제는 밥 먹으러 나가?
replies.koHigh: 나흘을 커피로 버티셨습니까? 이제는 식사하러 나가십니까?

replies.fr: La prochaine fois, ne reste pas seul : écris-moi tout de suite.
replies.en: Next time, don't wait alone; write to me right away.
replies.ko: 다음엔 혼자 참지 말고 바로 편지해요.
replies.koLow: 다음엔 혼자 참지 말고 바로 편지해.
replies.koHigh: 다음엔 혼자 참지 마시고 바로 편지해 주십시오.

memo.fr: Du pain et du café, de jeudi à lundi
memo.en: Bread and coffee, Thursday to Monday

text.fr: Il reste à Vincent 6 francs pour la semaine
text.en: Vincent has 6 francs left for the week

q.fr: Pendant 4 jours, de quoi Vincent a-t-il vécu ?
q.en: What did Vincent live on for 4 days?
q.ko: 빈센트는 나흘 동안 주로 무엇으로 버텼나요?

scene.ko: 돈이 떨어져 고생한 빈센트와 통화 · 사과와 고마움
scene.en: On the phone with Vincent, who ran out of money · sorry and thanks

lines.fr: Merci, Théo. Je suis resté sans argent jusqu'à lundi.
lines.en: Thanks, Theo. I was left without money until Monday.
lines.ko: 고마워요, 테오. 월요일까지 돈 없이 지냈어요.

lines.fr: Oh non, pardon ! Tu as mangé quoi ?
lines.en: Oh no, sorry! What did you eat?

lines.fr: Du café et du pain. Ce n'est pas ta faute.
lines.en: Coffee and bread. It's not your fault.

lines.fr: Désolé quand même. Écris-moi plus tôt, d'accord ?
lines.en: Sorry all the same. Write to me sooner, OK?
lines.ko: 그래도 미안해요. 다음엔 더 일찍 편지하세요, 네?

letters.dateNote: Undated in the 1914 edition; October 1888, between letters 546 and 555, both headed (October.).
letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 554 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: C'est cette fois-ci ma chambre à coucher tout simplement, seulement la couleur doit ici faire la chose et en donnant par sa simplification un style plus grand aux choses, être suggestive ici du repos ou du sommeil en général.
messages.en: This time it's simply my bedroom, only here colour has to do everything, and, by giving things a grander style through its simplification, be suggestive of rest or of sleep in general.
messages.ko: 이번엔 그냥 내 침실이야. 다만 여기선 색이 모든 걸 해내야 해. 단순하게 다듬어서 사물에 더 큰 품격을 주고, 쉼이나 잠 그 자체를 떠올리게 해야 하지.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: C'est cette fois-ci / ma chambre à coucher tout simplement, // seulement la couleur / doit ici faire la chose // et en donnant par sa simplification / un style plus grand aux choses, // être suggestive ici / du repos ou du sommeil en général.

messages.fr: Enfin la vue du tableau doit reposer la tête ou plutôt l'imagination.
messages.en: In short, looking at the picture should rest the mind, or rather the imagination.
messages.ko: 그러니까 이 그림을 보면 머리가, 아니 상상력이 쉬어야 해.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Enfin la vue du tableau / doit reposer la tête // ou plutôt l'imagination.

messages.fr: Les murs sont d'un violet pâle. Le sol est à carreaux rouges. Le bois du lit et les chaises sont jaune beurre frais, le drap et les oreillers citron vert très clair.
messages.en: The walls are pale violet. The floor is red tiles. The wood of the bed and the chairs are fresh-butter yellow, the sheet and the pillows a very light lemon green.
messages.ko: 벽은 옅은 보라야. 바닥은 붉은 타일이고. 침대 나무와 의자는 갓 만든 버터 같은 노랑, 시트와 베개는 아주 밝은 연둣빛 레몬색.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Les murs sont d'un violet pâle. // Le sol est à carreaux rouges. // Le bois du lit et les chaises / sont jaune beurre frais, // le drap et les oreillers / citron vert très clair.

messages.fr: La couverture rouge écarlate. La fenêtre verte. La table à toilette orangée, la cuvette bleue. Les portes lilas.
messages.en: The blanket scarlet red. The window green. The washstand orange, the basin blue. The doors lilac.
messages.ko: 이불은 진홍색. 창문은 초록. 세면대는 주황, 대야는 파랑. 문은 라일락색.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: La couverture rouge écarlate. // La fenêtre verte. // La table à toilette orangée, / la cuvette bleue. // Les portes lilas.

messages.fr: Et c'est tout — rien dans cette chambre à volets clos.
messages.en: And that's all: nothing in this room, with its shutters closed.
messages.ko: 그게 다야. 덧창을 닫은 이 방엔 아무것도 없어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Et c'est tout // — rien dans cette chambre / à volets clos.

note.ko: 빈센트는 1888년 10월에 처음 침실을 그렸고(암스테르담 반 고흐 미술관), 이듬해 생레미에서 두 번 더 그렸어요. 여기 실린 시카고 미술관의 그림은 1889년에 다시 그린 것이에요. 편지에서 말한 대로 그림자를 없애고, 평평하고 또렷한 색으로 칠했어요.
note.en: Vincent first painted the bedroom in October 1888 (Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam) and painted it twice more at Saint-Rémy the following year. The Art Institute of Chicago picture shown here is the 1889 repetition. As the letter says, the shadows are left out and the colour is laid on in flat, frank tints.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 554 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://www.artic.edu/artworks/28560

plate.why: The bedroom this letter describes, in the repetition Vincent painted in 1889; the Art Institute of Chicago releases it under CC0.

note.ko: ‘침대 나무는 갓 만든 버터 같은 노랑’.
note.en: ‘The wood of the bed … fresh-butter yellow’.

note.ko: ‘창문은 초록’. 덧창은 닫혀 있어요.
note.en: ‘The window green’, its shutters closed.

note.ko: ‘의자는 갓 만든 버터 같은 노랑’.
note.en: ‘The chairs … fresh-butter yellow’.

replies.fr: J'ai déjà envie de dormir dans cette chambre si calme.
replies.en: I already want to sleep in that quiet room.
replies.ko: 저도 벌써 그 조용한 방에서 자고 싶어요.
replies.koLow: 나도 벌써 그 조용한 방에서 자고 싶어.
replies.koHigh: 저도 벌써 그 조용한 방에서 자고 싶습니다.

replies.fr: Il y a beaucoup de couleurs, mais la chambre reste calme.
replies.en: There are many colours, but the room still feels calm.
replies.ko: 색은 많지만 방은 참 조용해 보여요.
replies.koLow: 색은 많지만 방은 참 조용해 보여.
replies.koHigh: 색은 많지만 방은 참 조용해 보입니다.

fr: Il y a beaucoup de couleurs
Il y a beaucoup des couleurs
Il y ont beaucoup de couleurs

q.fr: Que doit faire le tableau de la chambre ?
q.en: What should the bedroom painting do?
q.ko: 빈센트는 침실 그림이 무엇을 해 주길 바라나요?

scene.en: On the phone with Vincent, who has painted his bedroom

lines.fr: J'ai peint ma chambre, Théo. Juste ma chambre.
lines.en: I've painted my bedroom, Theo. Just my bedroom.
lines.ko: 침실을 그렸어요, 테오. 그냥 제 방이요.

lines.fr: Ta chambre ? Qu'est-ce qu'il y a dedans ?
lines.en: Your bedroom? What's in it?

lines.fr: Un lit, des chaises… C'est un tableau pour le repos.
lines.en: A bed, some chairs… It's a painting for rest.
lines.ko: 침대 하나, 의자 몇 개요… 쉬라고 그린 그림이에요.

lines.fr: Super idée. Et toi, tu as bien dormi hier ?
lines.en: Great idea. And you, did you sleep well last night?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 형은 어젯밤 잘 잤어요?

letters.dateNote: Undated in the 1914 edition; October 1888, after letter 555 (October.) and before Gauguin's arrival on 23 October.
letters.ref: Brieven 1914, n° 556 · Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

messages.fr: J'ai fait mettre le gaz dans l'atelier et dans la cuisine, ce qui me coûte 25 francs d'installations.
messages.en: I've had gas put in the studio and the kitchen, which costs me 25 francs for the fittings.
messages.ko: 작업실이랑 부엌에 가스를 들였어. 설치비로 25프랑이 들었어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: J'ai fait mettre le gaz / dans l'atelier et dans la cuisine, // ce qui me coûte / 25 francs d'installations.

messages.fr: Si Gauguin et moi travaillons une quinzaine tous les soirs, ne les regagnerons-nous pas ?
messages.en: If Gauguin and I work every evening for a fortnight, won't we earn it back?
messages.ko: 고갱이랑 내가 보름 동안 매일 저녁 일하면, 그 돈쯤은 다시 벌지 않겠어?
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Si Gauguin et moi / travaillons une quinzaine / tous les soirs, // ne les regagnerons-nous pas ?

messages.fr: Seulement comme d'ailleurs Gauguin peut maintenant venir de jour en jour, j'aurai absolument, absolument encore besoin de 50 francs au moins.
messages.en: Only, since Gauguin may now come any day, I'll absolutely, absolutely need at least another 50 francs.
messages.ko: 다만 고갱이 이제 언제라도 올 수 있으니까, 적어도 50프랑은 꼭, 정말 꼭 더 있어야 해.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Seulement comme d'ailleurs / Gauguin peut maintenant venir / de jour en jour, // j'aurai absolument, / absolument / encore besoin de 50 francs au moins.

messages.fr: Voici croquis bien vague de ma dernière toile, une rangée de cyprès verts contre un ciel rose avec un croissant citron pâle.
messages.en: Here's a very rough sketch of my latest canvas: a row of green cypresses against a pink sky with a pale lemon crescent moon.
messages.ko: 내 최근 그림을 아주 대충 스케치해 봤어. 분홍 하늘을 배경으로 초록 사이프러스가 줄지어 있고, 옅은 레몬빛 초승달이 떠 있어.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Voici croquis bien vague / de ma dernière toile, // une rangée de cyprès verts / contre un ciel rose // avec un croissant citron pâle.

messages.fr: Deux amoureux, l'homme bleu pâle à chapeau jaune, la femme à un corsage rose et une jupe noire. Cela fait la quatrième toile du « jardin du poète » qui est la décoration de la chambre à Gauguin.
messages.en: Two lovers: the man pale blue with a yellow hat, the woman in a pink bodice and a black skirt. That makes the fourth canvas of the ‘poet's garden’, which is the decoration for Gauguin's room.
messages.ko: 연인 두 사람. 남자는 옅은 파랑에 노란 모자, 여자는 분홍 블라우스에 검은 치마. 이걸로 ‘시인의 정원’이 네 점째야. 고갱 방을 꾸밀 그림들이지.
messages.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh

speak.fr: Deux amoureux, // l'homme bleu pâle / à chapeau jaune, // la femme à un corsage rose / et une jupe noire. // Cela fait la quatrième toile / du « jardin du poète » // qui est la décoration / de la chambre à Gauguin.

note.ko: 고갱은 1888년 10월 23일 아를에 도착했어요. 가스는 노란 집의 작업실과 부엌에 들였어요. 그림은 빈센트가 그해 9월에 그린 노란 집으로, 543번 편지에서 ‘유황빛 햇빛 아래, 순수한 코발트빛 하늘 아래 집과 그 주변’이라고 설명한 그림이에요.
note.en: Gauguin arrived in Arles on 23 October 1888. The gas went into the studio and the kitchen of the Yellow House. The picture is the Yellow House as Vincent painted it that September, the canvas he described in letter 543 as ‘the house and its surroundings under a sulphur sun, under a pure cobalt sky’.
note.source: Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 556 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; Brieven aan zijn broeder (J. van Gogh-Bonger, 1914), deel III, brief 543 · public domain · https://archive.org/details/brievenaanzijnbr03gogh ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vincent_van_Gogh_-_The_yellow_house_(%27The_street%27).jpg

plate.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Public domain
plate.why: The house where the gas was put in, painted that September; a public-domain image from Wikimedia Commons.

note.ko: 초록 문과 창이 있는 노란 집 1층. 이 집의 작업실과 부엌에 가스를 들였어요.
note.en: The ground floor of the Yellow House, with its green door and window. The gas went into the studio and kitchen of this house.

note.ko: 초록 덧창이 달린 2층. 위층에 침실들이 있었고, 그중 한 방을 고갱에게 내줄 참이었어요.
note.en: The upper floor with green shutters. The bedrooms were upstairs, and one of them was to be Gauguin's.

replies.fr: Tu as déjà le gaz dans l'atelier ? Je veux voir ça.
replies.en: You already have gas in the studio? I want to see that.
replies.ko: 작업실에 벌써 가스를 들였어요? 저도 보고 싶어요.
replies.koLow: 작업실에 벌써 가스를 들였어? 나도 보고 싶어.
replies.koHigh: 작업실에 벌써 가스를 들이셨습니까? 저도 보고 싶습니다.

replies.fr: Tu es sorti peindre les cyprès le soir ? Tu y vas souvent ?
replies.en: You went out to paint the cypresses at dusk? Do you go often?
replies.ko: 해 질 녘에 자주 사이프러스를 그리러 나가요?
replies.koLow: 해 질 녘에 자주 사이프러스를 그리러 나가?
replies.koHigh: 해 질 녘에 자주 사이프러스를 그리러 나가십니까?

text.fr: Gauguin est attendu à Arles · de jour en jour
text.en: Gauguin is expected in Arles · any day now
text.ko: 고갱이 아를에 올 날만 기다려요 · 이제 언제라도

status.fr: Gauguin peut venir de jour en jour

q.fr: Pourquoi Vincent a-t-il besoin de 50 francs de plus ?
q.en: Why does Vincent need 50 more francs?

scene.ko: 고갱을 기다리며 집을 꾸미는 빈센트와 통화
scene.en: On the phone with Vincent, getting the house ready for Gauguin

lines.fr: Théo, j'ai fait installer le gaz dans la cuisine.
lines.en: Theo, I've had gas put in the kitchen.

lines.fr: Bonne idée ! Gauguin est déjà arrivé ?
lines.en: Good idea! Has Gauguin arrived yet?

lines.fr: Pas encore, mais bientôt. Tu peux m'envoyer cinquante francs ?
lines.en: Not yet, but soon. Can you send me fifty francs?
lines.ko: 아직이요, 곧 와요. 50프랑 보내 줄 수 있어요?

lines.fr: Oui, d'accord. Et la toile pour sa chambre ?
lines.en: Yes, all right. And the canvas for his room?
lines.ko: 네, 그럴게요. 그 사람 방에 걸 그림은요?
